runs.market_commentary:
Asian equities were broadly constructive overnight, with the Nikkei 225 adding roughly +0.5% as yen softness and sustained AI-sector enthusiasm supported risk appetite. Bloomberg's Asia wrap headlined 'Asian stocks set to gain as oil extends declines,' with Brent crude sliding on demand concerns and a firmer dollar. Australian July CPI was the key regional data point, watched closely for any signs of re-acceleration that could complicate the RBA's easing trajectory. Hang Seng and broader EM indices traded mixed as Chinese macro sentiment remained cautious.

European markets closed with modest gains: the DAX rose +0.61% to 26,266 and the FTSE 100 advanced +0.29% to 10,886. Energy and utilities were mild drags given crude's continued slide, while industrial and tech names contributed positively. Volumes were light with no major European macro surprises, as traders awaited the heavy US data and event slate.

US equity futures are trading cautiously lower pre-market: S&P 500 futures off ~0.04%, Dow futures barely green at +0.06%, and Nasdaq-100 futures lagging at -0.39% (29,163) — software names are the primary drag. Two binary catalysts dominate the tape: July PCE inflation at 8:30 AM ET (consensus +0.1% m/m, +3.6% y/y, with sticky signals already flagged) and Nvidia's FQ2 FY2027 earnings after the close (consensus $2.09 EPS, $92.2B revenue, +97.4% YoY). Consumer Confidence came in at 89.4 in August, a miss vs. the 90.2 consensus, adding a modest headwind. Earnings guidance misses from Intuit (-9.2%), Zoom (-6.2%), and Kohl's (-7.4%) are pressuring software and retail sentiment, while Abercrombie (+11.5%) and Summit Therapeutics (+8.5%) are bright spots.

ideas.catalyst: FQ2 FY2027 earnings report due after close today; consensus EPS $2.09 (~+100% YoY), revenue $92.2B (+97.4% YoY).
ideas.thesis: Nvidia's Blackwell architecture is ramping into record hyperscaler capex cycles; a revenue or gross-margin beat plus upbeat data-center guidance could drive a meaningful gap-up. Underlying demand from AWS, Azure, Google, and Meta for GB200 clusters remains structurally robust and supply-constrained.
ideas.key_risk: Beat-and-retreat dynamic if guidance only meets elevated consensus; any softer data-center color would disappoint.

ideas.catalyst: UBS upgraded to Buy from Neutral today, raising price target to $1,400 from $960, implying ~46% upside.
ideas.thesis: argenx's Vyvgart (efgartigimod) FcRn inhibitor platform is expanding across multiple autoimmune indications including CIDP and ITP; UBS sees meaningful revenue upside not priced in at current levels. The company's differentiated mechanism of action and growing global commercial footprint underpin a durable competitive position.
ideas.key_risk: Any clinical setback in pipeline programs could sharply reverse the sentiment-driven upgrade.

sources.label: 247 Wall St Analyst Calls Wed Aug 26

ideas.catalyst: FDA PDUFA decision due August 27 on once-daily HIV regimen (bictegravir + lenacapavir); Trodelvy EU approval already secured; Q2 revenue +10% to $7.8B with raised FY guidance.
ideas.thesis: The pending FDA decision on a differentiated once-daily single-tablet HIV regimen could materially expand Gilead's dominant HIV franchise; approval would serve as a near-term catalyst with limited downside given existing revenue strength. Trodelvy's EU win and robust HIV sales trajectory ($5.7B, +12% YoY) support fundamental upside.
ideas.key_risk: FDA rejection or complete response letter would materially pressure shares into the binary event.

sources.label: Yahoo Finance GILD Retail Attention Story

ideas.catalyst: Positive clinical trial data released today; shares +8.5% in pre-market trading.
ideas.thesis: A meaningful positive clinical readout validates Summit's pipeline and frequently attracts partnership or M&A interest from larger pharmaceutical companies; early-stage catalysts of this magnitude tend to sustain multi-session momentum as analyst initiations and coverage additions follow. The data de-risks the near-term binary overhang.
ideas.key_risk: Small-cap binary risk remains; subsequent data sets may fail to replicate initial positive signal.

ideas.catalyst: Q2 EPS and revenue beat with raised full-year sales forecast; shares +11.5% pre-market.
ideas.thesis: Abercrombie's brand transformation continues to outperform even in a softening consumer backdrop; management's raised FY guidance signals genuine confidence in H2 execution. The outsized pre-market move on elevated volume typically draws momentum-driven follow-through for multiple sessions post-earnings.
ideas.key_risk: Consumer spending deceleration more severe than anticipated could compress margins and force a FY guidance reversal.

ideas.catalyst: UBS upgraded to Buy from Neutral; price target raised to $42 from $36 (+17% implied upside).
ideas.thesis: SolarEdge has been severely de-rated after a prolonged 2023-2025 downcycle; UBS's upgrade signals a potential bottoming process as European residential solar demand recovers and inventory digestion approaches completion. Risk/reward is asymmetric at these historically depressed valuations relative to the company's long-term market position.
ideas.key_risk: Further deterioration in European residential solar demand or continued pricing pressure from Chinese competitors would undermine recovery.

sources.label: 247 Wall St Analyst Calls Wed Aug 26

ideas.catalyst: Q3 guidance miss drives -6.2% pre-market despite Q2 earnings beat.
ideas.thesis: Zoom is caught in a structural squeeze as Microsoft Teams, Google Meet, and native AI communication tools erode enterprise market share, limiting pricing power; the guidance miss confirms ongoing growth deceleration likely to persist into FY2027. The premium valuation multiple is difficult to sustain without a meaningful reacceleration narrative.
ideas.key_risk: Strategic M&A interest from a larger platform player (e.g., Salesforce) could create a short-squeeze premium.

ideas.catalyst: Shares -9.2% pre-market after weak FY guidance overshadows Q2 EPS beat.
ideas.thesis: Intuit's weak FY guidance signals softening SMB spending and emerging competitive pressure from AI-native alternatives; at a premium forward multiple, guidance resets are disproportionately punishing. The guidance cut likely does not fully reflect potential market share erosion from free AI-powered tax and accounting alternatives.
ideas.key_risk: Guidance could prove conservative; AI-powered TurboTax and QuickBooks could accelerate user growth beyond current assumptions.

sources.label: Motley Fool Market Critical Test Aug 26

ideas.catalyst: Disappointing Q2 net sales and comparable sales; shares -7.4% pre-market.
ideas.thesis: Kohl's faces sustained structural headwinds from the ongoing shift to off-price retail (TJX, Ross) and e-commerce; the Q2 comp sales miss confirms that its attempted brand repositioning is failing to gain traction. With a compressed balance sheet and limited strategic flexibility, further multiple contraction is likely.
ideas.key_risk: Activist investor accumulation or leveraged buyout speculation could generate a short-squeeze dynamic.

ideas.theme: Natural Gas Infrastructure — Data Center Demand
ideas.catalyst: Wolfe Research upgraded to Outperform from Peer Perform today with a $145 price target.
ideas.thesis: Natural gas demand growth driven by data center power needs and rising LNG export volumes makes midstream infrastructure a secular beneficiary; DT Midstream's pure-play natural gas gathering and transport exposure gives it direct leverage to this structural tailwind. Wolfe's upgrade reflects improving volume and contract outlook not yet fully reflected in the stock's valuation.
ideas.key_risk: Natural gas price weakness or regulatory setbacks on pipeline permitting could delay volume growth and compress distributions.

deals.headline: Nvidia Reports FQ2 FY2027 Earnings After Close — $92.2B Revenue Expected
deals.description: Nvidia is set to report fiscal Q2 FY2027 results after market close today, with analyst consensus calling for EPS of $2.09 (nearly double the year-ago period) and revenue of $92.2 billion, up 97.4% year-over-year. The report is the single most consequential event for market sentiment this week, acting as a bellwether for global AI capex momentum.
deals.impact: High — will set tone for semiconductors, AI, and overall risk appetite
deals.sentiment: Bullish setup with high expectations bar

deals.headline: Gilead Sciences PDUFA: FDA Decision on Once-Daily HIV Regimen Due August 27
deals.description: The FDA is expected to deliver a ruling by August 27 on Gilead's once-daily single-tablet HIV regimen combining bictegravir and lenacapavir, targeting patients whose virus is already virologically suppressed. Gilead's Q2 results already showed HIV sales up 12% to $5.7B and Trodelvy securing an EU approval, establishing positive momentum ahead of the binary decision.
deals.impact: High — binary regulatory event with significant commercial implications

deals.headline: Bob Iger & Joshua Kushner Acquire LA Lakers for Record $12.5 Billion
deals.description: Former Disney CEO Bob Iger and investor Joshua Kushner are acquiring the Los Angeles Lakers in what is a record-setting sports franchise transaction at $12.5 billion. The deal represents the highest valuation ever achieved for a professional sports team and signals continued institutional appetite for premium sports IP as a media and entertainment asset class.
deals.impact: Medium — signals continued sports asset inflation; watch media and sports streaming names
deals.sentiment: Bullish for sports IP, broadly neutral for public markets

deals.headline: Madison Air to Acquire Airflow Technologies for $5.4 Billion
deals.description: Madison Air announced a definitive agreement to acquire Airflow Technologies for $5.4 billion, expanding its position in commercial and industrial HVAC and ventilation systems. The deal reflects continued consolidation in the energy-efficient building systems sector, driven by regulatory decarbonization mandates and rising infrastructure investment.
deals.impact: Medium — supportive for HVAC sector M&A comps and industrial peers

deals.headline: argenx Upgraded to Buy at UBS — Price Target Raised to $1,400 From $960
deals.description: UBS analyst team upgraded argenx (ARGX) to Buy from Neutral on Wednesday, boosting their 12-month price target to $1,400 from $960, implying approximately 46% upside from current levels. The upgrade reflects growing confidence in the commercial ramp of Vyvgart across multiple autoimmune indications and upcoming label expansions that were not fully priced into the prior Neutral rating.
deals.impact: High — 46% implied upside; could trigger institutional buying and consensus estimate revisions
